blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At finalized Ethereum block 26506658 (2026-11-27T12:51:35Z), FluidLiteVaultProxy 0x273da948aca9261043fbdb2a857bc255ecc29012 delegates to verified UUPS implementation FluidLiteVault 0xe16ccc91a8134d428e7b6240177f9e2b227b9743. The current implementation exposes ordinary OpenZeppelin ERC20 transfers without a holder blacklist, freeze, or transfer pause, while pauseDeposits() and pauseWithdrawals() (callable immediately by _secondaryOwner / AUTH_LEVEL 0x4f6f977acdd1177dcd81ab83074855ecb9c2d49e) can halt minting and redemptions. Crucially, _authorizeUpgrade() is active and gated only by _owner (FluidTimelockController 0x4d6ce4f4498d59eed397bcbc687805a07f9b2346, 24-hour delay, proposed by the 6-of-12 Fluid team Avocado multisig), allowing governance to replace token transfer and redemption logic. Direct active upgradeability classifies as possible and takes precedence over inherited upstream Circle USDC freeze exposure. Verdict: possible.

oracleRisk.summary: FluidLiteVault.convertToAssets() and totalAssets() price shares exclusively from an internal auto-accruing _exchangePrice (the maximum of _fixedRate, 6.00% APR as of 2026-11-27, and _rewardAmountPerYear, $3M per year divided by totalSupply), updated upward during StrategyHandler reconciliations via updateExchangePrice() up to +200 bps per call. updateExchangePrice() explicitly reverts on downward updates, and vault totalAssets() does not read live strategy mark-to-market balances; StrategyHandler separately references upgradeable FluidPriceOracleProxy 0x9b9dba36eb22586c228c3bf81138373096036300 for off-vault strategy accounting. No borrower liquidation engine consumes the fLiteUSD share price directly.

branchApplicability.rationale: fLiteUSD minting and redemption convert shares at the contract's internal auto-accruing exchange price controlled by StrategyHandler rate and reconciliation calls; the vault has no borrower positions or collateral liquidation branches, so oracle risk applies to the top-level conversion path only.
